Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a business and occupation tax credit for certain small business purchases.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a business and occupation tax credit for smallbusiness; and adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing the tax imposed under this chapter, a credit isallowed for investment in computers and preinstalled software on thosecomputers, used by an eligible person exclusively for businesspurposes. The credit is equal to the purchase price of the propertymultiplied by ten percent. (2) No application is necessary for the tax credit. Persons takingthe credit are subject to all of the requirements of chapter 82.32 RCW.In no case may a credit earned during one calendar year be carried overto be credited against taxes incurred in a subsequent calendar year.No refunds may be granted for credits under this section. Credit takenin any one calendar year may not exceed twenty million dollars, andcredit taken under this section by any one person may not exceed onehundred ten dollars per computer. p. 1 HB 3146 (3) For purposes of this section, "eligible person" means a personas defined in RCW 82.04.030, who is a "small business" as defined inRCW 19.85.020.
